studies.note: Their numbers are theirs, ours are ours. Public studies measure AI plans in general; ours count what our validator actually finds on Slovenian plans — since we started counting.

method.title: How we count (honestly)
method.counting: Only a completed check counts — the event is written by the server when the report is computed, not on click.
method.start: Counting starts with version 1.21.0; we do not back-fill history.
method.privacy: No personal data: we store only counts (days, stops, issue types) — never the plan text.
method.cache: The page reads numbers from a 60-second cache, so they may lag by a minute.

states.unavailable: Telemetry is temporarily unavailable — the public studies below stand independently of it.
states.empty: No completed checks since counting started — the numbers will grow with every report. Until then, the public studies below explain why we count.
